summary: No unsupported, wrong or outdated claims found after opening all listed sources. Prose is localized rather than translated. Minor issues: 'Dans l'aperçu de l'ATP' is a calque of 'previa', and the section 'Lire les classements avec prudence' contains an internal editorial note ('il faut donc vérifier... avant de présenter ce rang comme actuel') that should not appear in reader-facing text. Process note: the Washington semi-final ATP page labels Washington an 'ATP 500' event, contradicting the earlier established fact; neither locale's text uses that label.
